title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #19

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these shows respect for the differences among people? (1 mark)
   A. Giving people nicknames about their bodies
   B. Leaving out children who look different
   C. Laughing at how others speak
   D. Playing with children from different backgrounds

2. Who are your grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Your brothers
   B. Your neighbours
   C. The parents of your mother or father
   D. Your uncles

3. Why should Christians respect their bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Because of money
   B. Because they are proud
   C. The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   D. Because it is fashionable

4. What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are? (1 mark)
   A. Property of strangers
   B. Toys
   C. Machines
   D. Temples of the Holy Spirit

5. Which of these is the first book of the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Romans
   B. Matthew
   C. Genesis
   D. Acts

6. What does it mean to say that the Bible is inspired? (1 mark)
   A. People invented it
   B. The writers copied other books
   C. God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   D. It was written in one day

7. What was Zacchaeus' job? (1 mark)
   A. Fisherman
   B. Chief tax collector
   C. Priest
   D. Shepherd

8. Why did people dislike tax collectors? (1 mark)
   A. Many took more money than they should
   B. They were teachers
   C. They were farmers
   D. They were poor

9. How many times did the donkey turn aside or stop before she spoke? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Five
   C. One
   D. Seven

10. What gave Samson the strength to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Special food
   B. The Spirit of the Lord
   C. His parents
   D. His long hair alone

11. What is a judge in the book of Judges? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   C. A priest
   D. A court officer today

12. How many came back to thank Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. None
   B. Ten
   C. One
   D. Nine

13. When were the ten men healed? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Before they heard Him
   C. After many years
   D. As they went

14. What did Jesus say to the woman? (1 mark)
   A. Follow me
   B. Give me water
   C. Go home
   D. Don't cry

15. What does it mean to forgive? (1 mark)
   A. To hide
   B. To forget your name
   C. To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   D. To hit back

16. What did the woman do when she lost one coin? (1 mark)
   A. Waited
   B. Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   C. Gave up
   D. Bought another

17. What does planting trees do for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Cares for the environment
   B. Kills birds
   C. Harms the soil
   D. Wastes water

18. What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God? (1 mark)
   A. Old
   B. Rich
   C. A priest
   D. Born again

19. What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51? (1 mark)
   A. He is a liar
   B. He is a king
   C. Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   D. Let us punish Him

20. What did Joseph say about doing the wrong thing? (1 mark)
   A. I do not care
   B. How could I sin against God?
   C. It is fun
   D. Maybe later

21. Which commandment forbids false testimony? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:16
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Exodus 20:3
   D. Exodus 20:15

22. What are the two greatest commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Love God and love your neighbour
   B. Buy and sell
   C. Work and rest
   D. Pray and fast

23. Who did the disciples rebuke? (1 mark)
   A. The Pharisees
   B. The soldiers
   C. The children
   D. The people bringing children

24. In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what does Paul call the body of a believer? (1 mark)
   A. Toys
   B. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   C. Property of strangers
   D. Machines

25. Which verse mentions activities such as a hymn and a word of instruction? (1 mark)
   A. 1 Corinthians 14:26
   B. John 3:16
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Luke 1:37

26. Who preached to the crowd at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Stephen
   C. Thomas
   D. Judas

27. How many disciples did Jesus choose? (1 mark)
   A. Twenty
   B. Seven
   C. Twelve
   D. Ten

28. Which of these is a person you can pray for? (1 mark)
   A. Your parents
   B. Only leaders
   C. No one
   D. Only yourself

29. Which verses list the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Galatians 5:22-23
   D. Luke 1:37

30. Which number can children call for help in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 116
   C. 10
   D. 200

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe four ways in which a child can trust God in life's challenges. (4 marks)

32. Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents. (5 marks)

33. Describe three steps in planting and caring for a seed. (3 marks)

34. Describe four steps you can follow when you feel very angry with someone. (4 marks)

35. Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways. (4 marks)

36. Describe how the boy in John 6 shows that small gifts can do great things. (4 marks)

37. Name two needs that people may have. (2 marks)

38. Explain why Christians should show the fruit of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

39. Explain three ways in which children can show God's love to others. (3 marks)

40. State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation. (4 marks)

41. Explain why trusting God is important and how a child shows that they trust Him. (5 marks)

42. Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means. (3 marks)

43. Give two reasons why we should not take revenge. (2 marks)

44. Give two sins that do not please God. (2 marks)

45. Give two examples of school property. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Playing with children from different backgrounds
   Respecting differences shows that we value all of God's creation.

2. C — The parents of your mother or father
   Grandparents are the mothers and fathers of your parents.

3. C — The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

4. D — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

5. B — Matthew
   Matthew is the first of the four Gospels and of the New Testament.

6. C — God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   2 Timothy 3:16 teaches that Scripture is inspired by God.

7. B — Chief tax collector
   Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector.

8. A — Many took more money than they should
   Many tax collectors cheated people.

9. A — Three
   Balaam struck her three times.

10. B — The Spirit of the Lord
   The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him.

11. B — A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   Judges were leaders who rescued Israel.

12. C — One
   Only one returned.

13. D — As they went
   Luke 17:14 says they were cleansed as they went.

14. D — Don't cry
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

15. C — To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   Forgiving lets go of revenge.

16. B — Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   Luke 15:8 says she searched carefully.

17. A — Cares for the environment
   Trees give shade, fruit and homes for birds.

18. D — Born again
   John 3:3 records this.

19. C — Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

20. B — How could I sin against God?
   Genesis 39:9 records his answer.

21. A — Exodus 20:16
   Exodus 20:16 forbids false testimony.

22. A — Love God and love your neighbour
   Matthew 22:37-39.

23. D — The people bringing children
   They told off those who brought the children.

24. B — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The body is a temple.

25. A — 1 Corinthians 14:26
   1 Corinthians 14:26 lists activities in worship.

26. A — Peter
   Peter spoke boldly.

27. C — Twelve
   Matthew 10:1 speaks of twelve.

28. A — Your parents
   We pray for parents, friends and others.

29. C — Galatians 5:22-23
   Galatians 5:22-23.

30. B — 116
   Childline Kenya.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray; read the Bible; ask trusted adults; do their best; thank God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dig a hole, plant the seed and cover it, water it regularly, protect it, watch it grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stop and breathe, count to ten, walk away if needed, tell a trusted adult, pray, forgive and make peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus used them to feed a large crowd. This shows that a small gift given willingly can help many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy sharing, 1 for the food, 1 for Jesus feeding many, 1 for the lesson.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing, shelter, medicine, school items, friendship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid need.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: It pleases God, makes us like Jesus, and helps us to live well with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Share, help the sick, forgive, speak kindly, include others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: God made us, loves us and is faithful. He hears prayers and has helped people in the Bible. A child shows trust by praying every day, reading the Bible, obeying His teaching, and thanking Him for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for faithfulness, 1 for prayer, 1 for Bible or obedience, 1 for thanks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: It starts a cycle of hurt; it gets us in trouble; it breaks friendships; it displeases God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lying, stealing, disobedience, bullying, jealousy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Desks, textbooks, library books, toilets, compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
